example.description: API-shape example with max_harmonic=0; N=0 does not demonstrate matrix convergence against the exact kinetic dielectric.
example.expected: PASS: the example runs locally and returns the declared output structure.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for undefined L-pole tables, invalid `j_order`/harmonic controls, nonfinite state, or singular source resonance denominators.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iteration or eigensolve occurs; undefined tables or singular resonances raise instead of returning a partial matrix.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No matrix mapping is returned after an exception.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Assembly arithmetic errors propagate; no fitted-matrix fallback is returned.

assumptions: Listed-species linear response; electron-only case2 does not establish global charge neutrality or a self-consistent background equilibrium.
identity.boundary: homogeneous linear response; explicit resonances and analytic removable limits
identity.coordinates: Cartesian SI; exp(i k·x−i ωt); signed gyrofrequency and radius
identity.definition: M acts on [Jx_snl,Jy_snl,Jz_snl,Ey,Ez,By,Bz]; polynomial conductivity restores four matrix entries; n>=1 inverse moments are reported from the sole stable-Gamma coefficient table; model targets are descriptive and no projection is applied.
identity.geometry: uniform background B along z; wavevector (kx,0,kz)
identity.model: static isotropic Maxwellian plasma or its declared numerical approximation

inputs.constraints: Finite numeric fields and coherent thermal/gyro scales; metadata cannot override explicit controls.
inputs.description: Explicit isotropic Maxwellian SI state. S species; c2; signed wcs and rhocs; positive wps2 and vts; optional metadata w and signed kz. Matrix assembly additionally requires epsilon0. rho=vts/(sqrt(2)*wcs). Explicit omega is authoritative; state w is not required.
inputs.name: state
inputs.shape: mapping; species vectors length S; numeric arrays retain MATLAB shapes
inputs.units: c2 m²/s²; wcs,w rad/s; wps2 s^-2; rhocs m; vts m/s; kz m^-1; epsilon0 F/m

inputs.description: Explicit angular frequency, authoritative over state metadata.
inputs.name: omega

outputs.constraints: State and terminal diagnostics retain scientific meaning; no caller state mutation.
outputs.description: M entries carry mixed-state SI dimensions for kx X=M X; corrected poles, measured inverse_moment_diagnostics, state, omega and N.
outputs.name: result
outputs.units: mixed SI and dimensionless as described

summary: Assemble the complete finite L/J matrix with restored conductivity polynomials and measured source-table diagnostics.

title.zh: 修正的有限有理 EM 矩阵

scope: Independent basis: det(M) recomputed from the assembled matrix bytes at 40 mpmath digits equals the product of that matrix's eigenvalues -- an identity that shares no code with the assembly or the solver.
The declared structural identities are checked on the returned object: order 40 at max_harmonic 0, the exact nonzero count, and the pole-table order the assembly consumed.

Test matrix: EM case 2 at a fixed frequency with J8 and max_harmonic 0; the same identity was also measured at the default max_harmonic 6 (490x490, 77095 nonzeros) to confirm it survives the large case.

Failure matrix: one assertion per channel -- a wrong constitutive block (determinant identity), a dropped pole or misplaced field row (order and nonzero count), a substituted pole table (declared order).
Precision budget, written before measurement: 1e-12 relative on the determinant identity; the measured value is 2.6e-14 at max_harmonic 0 and 6.1e-12 at the 490x490 default.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to EM case 2, J8, at a fixed frequency. Established by an independent 40-digit determinant identity at two matrix orders, measured at 2.6e-14 and 6.1e-12 relative, plus the declared order, sparsity and pole-table identities. Excluded scope: the J12 witness, max_harmonic above 0 in the committed test, and any identity with the exact Bessel/Z kinetic dielectric.
known_limitations: The J-pole and harmonic tables, and the EM deck constants, have no independent source in this repository and are recorded as cannot establish.
The 490x490 determinant check costs about a minute and is recorded in this contract as a measured value; the committed test uses max_harmonic 0 to stay fast.
